unary_attributes.name: Is
unary_attributes.description: Checks if {obj} belongs to the category {class_name}

unary_position_absolute.name: OnLeftSide
unary_position_absolute.description: {obj}'s center is in the left half of the image (center_x < width/2)

unary_position_absolute.name: OnRightSide
unary_position_absolute.description: {obj}'s center is in the right half of the image (center_x > width/2)

unary_position_absolute.name: OnTopSide
unary_position_absolute.description: {obj}'s center is in the top half of the image (center_y < height/2)

unary_position_absolute.name: OnBottomSide
unary_position_absolute.description: {obj}'s center is in the bottom half of the image (center_y > height/2)

binary_position_relative.name: LeftOf
binary_position_relative.description: Object {A}'s center is to the left of Object {B}'s center (A.center_x < B.center_x)

binary_position_relative.name: RightOf
binary_position_relative.description: Object {A}'s center is to the right of Object {B}'s center (A.center_x > B.center_x)

binary_position_relative.name: Above
binary_position_relative.description: Object {A}'s center is vertically above Object {B}'s center (A.center_y < B.center_y)

binary_position_relative.name: Below
binary_position_relative.description: Object {A}'s center is vertically below Object {B}'s center (A.center_y > B.center_y)

binary_alignment.name: AlignedHorizontally
binary_alignment.description: Object {A} and Object {B} share roughly the same center Y coordinate

binary_alignment.name: AlignedVertically
binary_alignment.description: Object {A} and Object {B} share roughly the same center X coordinate

binary_comparison.name: LargerThan
binary_comparison.description: Object {A} has a larger bounding box area than Object {B}

binary_comparison.name: SmallerThan
binary_comparison.description: Object {A} has a smaller bounding box area than Object {B}
